objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Two-wheeled vehicle with a step-through frame, small wheels (10-16 inches), and a low-powered gasoline engine. objects.taxonomy_description: Handheld collapsible canopy mounted on a central shaft with radiating ribs. Canopy is fabric (nylon, polyester) stretched over 6-8 metal or fiberglass ribs. When open, diameter is 90-120 cm. Shaft is metal or wood with a curved or straight handle. Collapsible models fold down to 25-35 cm via a telescoping shaft and folding ribs. Canopy colors range from solid black to vibrant patterns. Tip of each rib has a small protective cap. Opening mechanism is manual (push-up) or automatic (button-activated). Ribs converge at a runner that slides along the shaft.
